SMS Program Terms (Text Messaging)
Program name: Trispark text messaging program, operated by Trispark(doing business as Trispark).
Program description: Text messages for job candidates and employer/client contacts of Trispark, a staffing and recruiting company.

Types of messages: (a) Customer care messages you consent to receive: application status updates, interview scheduling and reminders, shift confirmations, onboarding updates, and candidate or hiring updates for employers. (b) Marketing messages, only if you separately opt in: new job openings and staffing opportunities.

How to opt in: Check the applicable unchecked box next to your mobile number on our Contact Us form ( https://www.patternshiring.com/contact-us ) or on the Submit Your Resume form on our home page ( https://www.patternshiring.com/#submit-resume ). You may opt in to customer care messages only, or to both customer care and marketing messages. Consent is not a condition of purchase or of applying for a job, and you can use our services without opting in.
Message frequency: Varies based on your activity. If you opt in to marketing messages, up to 4 messages per week.
Cost: Trispark does not charge for text messages. Message and data rates may apply under your mobile plan.

How to opt out: Reply STOP to any message at any time (UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END and QUIT also work). You will receive one confirmation message and no further messages. To rejoin, reply START or opt in again on our website.
Help: Reply HELP to any message, or contact us at info@patternshiring.com or +1 (302) 485-0400 .
Carriers: Wireless carriers and Trispark are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. The program is available for U.S. mobile numbers only.

Privacy: We will not sell, rent or share your mobile number or opt-in data with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. See our Privacy Policy ( https://www.patternshiring.com/privacy-policy ).
Changes: We may update these SMS Program Terms. The current version is always posted on this page.
